reason: Original confirmation completed 11 of 16 workers; five failed because the index-mean projection assigned zero likelihood to an actually emitted observation. No original confirmation efficacy means were used to change models, thresholds or sample counts.
new_namespace: 4*10^12 + fit_seed*10^5 + domain_offset + index; no mixing with old confirmation namespace3
unchanged: world law, prices, action semantics and time intervals
four primary arms and eight other valid secondary arms
fit-level formulas, two-domain testing family and acceptance thresholds
sole_execution_revision: Only exact ValueError Impossible observation from mean_value/BeliefMemory.observe with likelihood exactly zero is isolated as invalid_support. It receives null reward/utility, no fallback or epsilon. All other exceptions remain fatal.
mean_policy: Attempt every fresh episode to retain coverage/failure evidence. If any mean_value episode fails, all D-minus-mean claims are null; no success-only performance aggregates. Report counts and spent CPU.
statistical_scope: Supplemental independent confirmation after an openly recorded initial failure; not successful completion of the original protocol. Original 11 successes and five failures excluded from new effect estimates. Independent units remain the same eight fitted seeds, not sixteen fits.
cost_scope: Original failed campaign, supplemental campaign, training, diagnostics, development and publication records retained. Old failure CPU is cumulative research infrastructure, separately disclosed from deployment alternative cost curves; no disappearing attempts.
publication_gate: Publish supplemental source/protocol/manifest and references to all original frozen training files; read back exact blob identities before generating any namespace4 confirmation world.
new_progress_archive: Every completed paired episode is appended as one complete plain JSONL line, flushed and fsynced. This preserves completed evidence without requiring a gzip trailer; it is not full owner crash-resume. This work is research infrastructure CPU, not extra arm inference.
mean_episode_rule: Every one of the 128 episodes per fit/domain is attempted independently. A failure terminates only that mean episode; no retry/reset/fallback in it. The next independent episode uses original initialization. Coverage denominator is all128, not successful cases.
deployment_cost_formula: Unchanged original gate: all training-search worker CPU + one preparation/checkpoint + N*online CPU, at N=1000 and online, D/B <= .90 in both domains with original NI guard. Cumulative research expense is a distinct ledger including all old attempts; it does not replace or change this gate.
